text.S1: There once was a little girl whose hair was bright and yellow ,and it glittered in the sun like spun-gold. Her name was Goldi-Locs.
text.S2: Once upon a time there was a little girl whose hair was bright and yellow ,and it glittered in the sun like spun-gold. Her name was Goldi-Locs.
text.T1: Kalekale panali mtsikana wacicepere yemwe anali ndi tsitsi lowala ndi lacikasu, ndipo limanyezimira kudzuwa ngati golide wowumba. Dzina lake linali Goldi-locs.
text.T2: Kalekale panali mtsikana wacicepere yemwe anali ndi tsitsi lowala ndi lacikasu, ndipo limanyezimira padzuwa ngati golide wowumba. Dzina lake linali Goldi-locs.

text.S1: One day Goldi-Locs went out to gather flowers. She wandered on and on, and after a while she came to a forest, where she had never been before. She went into the forest, which was very cool and shady.
text.S2: One day Goldi-Locs went out to gather flowers. She wandered on and on, and after a while she came to a forest, where she had never been before. She went into the forest, which was very cool and shady.
text.T1: Tsiku lina Goldi-Locs anapita kukafuna maluwa. Anayendayenda, ndipo patapita nthawi analowa kunkhalango, kumene anali asanapiteko. Analowa m’nkhalango momwe munali mozizira kwambirindi mwamthunzi.
text.T2: Tsiku lina Goldi-Locs anapita kukafuna maluwa. Anayendayenda, ndipo patapita nthawi analowa kunkhalango, kumene anali asanapiteko. Analowa m’nkhalango momwe munali mozizira kwambiri ndi mwamthunzi.

text.S1: She came to a house standing all alone in the forest. She knocked at the door, as she was tired, hungry and thirsty, and she hoped the good people inside would give her some food and drink, and let her rest a little while.
text.S2: She came to a house standing all alone in the forest. She knocked at the door, as she was tired, hungry and thirsty, and she hoped the good people inside would give her some food and drink, and let her rest a little while.
text.T1: Iye anafika panyumba ina imene ciimirire yokha m’nkhalango. Iye anagogoda pacitseko, cifukwa anali wotopa, njala ndi ludzu, ndipo anaganizira kuti anthu abwino amene ali m’kati angamupatseko cakudya ndi cakumwa, ndipo kuti amulole kuti apumule kwa nthawi yocepa.
text.T2: Iye anafika panyumba ina imene inali ciimirire yokha m’nkhalango. Iye anagogoda pacitseko, cifukwa anali wotopa, njala ndi ludzu, ndipo anaganizira kuti anthu abwino amene ali m’kati angamupatseko cakudya ndi cakumwa, ndipo kuti amulole kuti apumule kwa nthawi yocepa.

text.S1: Although Goldi-Locs did not know it, this house belonged to three lions. There was GREAT BIG FATHER LION, mid-sized mother lion, and dear little baby lion who was no bigger than Goldi-Locs. The three lions had gone out for a walk while their supper was cooling, so when Goldi-Locs knocked at the door no one answered.
text.S2: Although Goldi-Locs did not know it, this house belonged to three lions. There was GREAT BIG FATHER LION, mother was of middle size, and dear little baby lion who was no bigger than Goldi-Locs. The three lions had gone out for a walk while their supper was cooling, so when Goldi-Locs knocked at the door no one answered.
text.T1: Ngakhale kuti Gold-Locs sanadziwe ciliconse, nyumba imeneyi inali nyumba yamikango itatu. Panali MKANGO WAUKULU YEMWE ANALI TATE, mayi anali wapakati pamnsinkhu, ndipo mwana wamkango wokondedwa sanali wokulirapo polinganiza ndi Goldi Locs. Mikango itatu ija inali itapita kokayenda pamene cakudya camadzulo cinali kuphikidwa, tsopano pamene Goldi-Locs atagogoda pacitseko panalibe amene anayankha.
text.T2: Ngakhale kuti Gold-Locs sanadziwe ciliconse, nyumba imeneyi inali nyumba yamikango itatu. Panali MKANGO WAUKULU YEMWE ANALI TATE, mayi wapakati pamnsinkhu, ndipo mwana wamkango wokondedwa wosakulirapo polinganiza ndi Goldi Locs. Mikango itatu ija inali itapita kokayenda pamene cakudya camadzulo cinali kufunda, tsopano pamene Goldi-Locs atagogoda pacitseko panalibe amene anayankha.

text.S1: She paused and she knocked again. As nobody answered she pushed the door open and stepped inside. There in a row stood three chairs. One was a GREAT BIG CHAIR, and it belonged to the father lion. And one was a middling-sized chair, and it belonged to the mother lion, and one was a dear little chair, and it belonged to the baby lion. And on the table stood three bowls of smoking hot porridge. “And so,” thought Goldi-Locs, “people must be coming back soon to eat it.”
text.S2: She paused and she knocked again. As nobody answered she pushed the door open and stepped inside. There in a row stood three chairs. One was a GREAT BIG CHAIR, and it belonged to the father lion. And one was a middling-sized chair, and it belonged to the mother lion, and one was a dear little chair, and it belonged to the baby lion. And on the table stood three bowls of smoking hot porridge. “And so,” thought Goldi-Locs, “people must be coming back soon to eat it.”
text.T1: Iye anayembekezera pang’ono ndipo anagogodanso. Ndiye pakuti panalibe amene anayankha iye anakankha citseko ndipo cinatsekuka, ndipo analowa m’kati. Munali mipando itatu mumndandanda. Ndipo umodzi unali MPANDO WAUKULU, ndipo unali wa atate mkango. Ndipo mpando wina unali pakati koma wocepekera,ndipo unali wa mkango waukazi, ndipo wina unali mpando waung’ono wa mkango wokondeka wacicepere, ndipo unali wamwana wamkango. Patebulo panali mbale zitatu momwe munali phala lotentha lotuluka nthunzi. “Tsopano,” anaganizira Gold-Locs “anthu ayenera kubwera catsopano apa kuti adzadye phala ili.”
text.T2: Iye anayembekezera pang’ono ndipo anagogodanso. Ndiye pakuti panalibe amene anayankha iye anakankha citseko ndipo cinatsekuka, ndipo analowa m’kati. Munali mipando itatu mumndandanda. Ndipo umodzi unali MPANDO WAUKULU, ndipo unali wa atate mkango. Ndipo mpando wina unali pakati koma wocepekera,ndipo unali wa mkango waukazi, ndipo wina unali mpando waung’ono wa mkango wokondeka wacicepere, ndipo unali wamwana wamkango. Patebulo panali mbale zitatu momwe munali phala lotentha lotuluka nthunzi. “Tsopano,” anaganizira Gold-Locs “anthu ayenera kubwera catsopano apa kuti adzadye phala ili.”

text.S1: She thought she would sit down and rest until they came. First she sat down in the GREAT BIG CHAIR, but the cushion was too soft. It seemed as though she would be swallowed. Then she sat down in the middle-sized chair, and the cushion was too hard, and it was not comfortable. Then she sat down in the dear little chair, and it was just right. It fitted her as though it had been made for her. So there she sat, and she rocked and she rocked, and she sat and she sat, until with her rocking and her sitting she sat the bottom right out of it.
text.S2: She thought she would sit down and rest until they came. First she sat down in the GREAT BIG CHAIR, but the cushion was too soft. It seemed as though she would be swallowed. Then she sat down in the middle-sized chair, and the cushion was too hard, and it was not comfortable. Then she sat down in the dear little chair, and it was just right. It fitted her as though it had been made for her. So there she sat, and she rocked and she rocked, and she sat and she sat, until with her rocking and her sitting she sat the bottom right out of it.
text.T1: Iye anaganiza kuti akhale pansi ndi kupumula mpakaatabwera. Coyamba iye anakhala pansi PAMPANDO WAUKULU, koma wofuwofu wake unali wofewa kwambiri. Zimaoneka ngati kuti angamezedwe. Pambuyo pake, iye anakhala pansi pampando umene unali wocepekerapo, ndipo wofuwofu wake unali wolimba, ndipo sipamamveka bwino. Ndiye iye tsopano anakhala pansi pampando wawokondedwa, ndipo unali kumveka bwino. Unamuyenera monga kuti unali utapangidwira iye. Cotero anakhala, analumpha ndikulumpha ndipo iye anakhala pansi, ndipo polumpha ndi kukhala anakhala kunsi kwake.
text.T2: Iye anaganiza kuti akhale pansi ndi kupumula mpaka atabwera. Coyamba iye anakhala pansi PAMPANDO WAUKULU, koma wofuwofu wake unali wofewa kwambiri. Zimaoneka ngati kuti angamezedwe. Pambuyo pake, iye anakhala pansi pampando umene unali wocepekerapo, ndipo wofuwofu wake unali wolimba, ndipo sipamamveka bwino. Ndiye iye tsopano anakhala pansi pampando wawokondedwa, ndipo unali kumveka bwino. Unamuyenera monga kuti unali utapangidwira iye. Cotero anakhala, analumpha ndikulumpha ndipo iye anakhala pansi, ndipo polumpha ndi kukhala anakhala kunsi kwake.

text.S1: And nobody had come, and there stood three bowls of porridge on the table. “They must not be very hungry people,” thought Goldi-Locs to herself. Or they would have come home to eat their supper.” And she went over to the table just to see whether the bowls were full.
text.S2: And nobody had come, and there were three bowls of porridge on the table. “They must people who are not very hungry,” thought Goldi-Locs to herself. Or they would have come home to eat their supper.” And she went over to the table just to see whether the bowls were full.
text.T1: Ndipo palibe anabwera, ndipo panali mbale zitatu za phala patebulo. “Iwo sali anthu amene ali ndi njala kwambiri,” anaganizira Goldi-Locs payekha. “Mwinamwake akanabwera kuti adye cakudya camadzulo.” Ndipo iye anapita patebulocabe kukaona ngati kuti mbale zimenezo zinali zodzala.
text.T2: Ndipo palibe anabwera, ndipo panali mbale zitatu za phala patebulo. “Iwo sali anthu amene ali ndi njala kwambiri,” anaganizira Goldi-Locs payekha. “Mwinamwake akanabwera kuti adye cakudya camadzulo.” Ndipo iye anapita patebulo cabe kukaona ngati kuti mbale zimenezo zinali zodzala.

text.S1: The first bowl was a GREAT BIG BOWL with a GREAT BIG WOODEN SPOON in it, and that was the father lion’s bowl. The second bowl was a middle-sized bowl, with a middle-sized wooden spoon in it, and that was the mother lion’s bowl. And the third bowl was a dear little bowl, with a dear little silver spoon in it, and that was the baby lion’s bowl.
text.S2: The first bowl was a GREAT BIG BOWL where was a GREAT BIG WOODEN SPOON, and that was the father lion’s bowl. The second bowl was a middle-sized bowl, in it was a middle-sized wooden spoon in it, and that was the mother lion’s bowl. And the third bowl was a dear little bowl, with a dear little silver spoon in it, and that was the baby lion’s bowl.
text.T1: Mbale yoyamba inali MBALE YAIKULU momwe munali SIPUNI YAMTENGO YAIKULU, ndipo imeneyo inali mbale ya tate mkango. Mbale yaciwiri inali yokulirapo pang’ono, m’kati munali sipuni yamtengo, ndipo mbale imeneyi inali ya mayi mkango. Ndipo mbale ina inali mbale ya wokondedwa wam’ng’ono, ndipo m’kati mwake munali kasipuni kasiliva kabwino, ndipo imeneyo inali mbale ya mwana wamkango.
text.T2: Mbale yoyamba inali MBALE YAIKULU kwambiri momwe munali SIPUNI YAMATAMBWA YAIKULU, ndipo imeneyo inali mbale ya tate mkango. Mbale yaciwiri inali yokulirapo pang’ono, m’kati munali sipuni yamatabwa, ndipo mbale imeneyi inali ya mayi mkango. Ndipo mbale yacitatu inali mbale yaing’ono yokondedwa, ndipo m’kati mwake munali kasipuni kasiliva kakang’ono kokondedwa, ndipo imeneyo inali mbale ya mwana wamkango.

text.S1: The porridge that was in the bowls smelled so very good that Goldi-Locs thought she would taste it.
text.S2: The porridge that was in the bowls smelled so very good that Goldi-Locs thought she would taste it.
text.T1: Phala limene linali m’mbale zija linanunkhira bwino kwambiri kotero kuti Goldi-Locs amaganizira zoilawa.
text.T2: Phala limene linali m’mbale zija linanunkhira bwino kwambiri kotero kuti Goldi-Locs amaganizira zolilawa.

text.S1: She took the GREAT BIG SPOON and tasted the porridge in the GREAT BIG BOWL, but it was too hot. Then she took the middle-sized spoon and tasted the porridge in the middle-sized bowl, and it was too cold. Then she took the little silver spoon and tasted the porridge in the dear little bowl, and it was just right. It tasted so good that she tasted and tasted, and tasted and tasted until she tasted it all up.
text.S2: She took the GREAT BIG SPOON and tasted the porridge in the GREAT BIG BOWL, but it was too hot. Then she took the middle-sized spoon and tasted the porridge in the middle-sized bowl, and it was too cold. Then she took the little silver spoon and tasted the porridge in the dear little bowl, and it was just right. It tasted so good that she tasted and tasted, and tasted and tasted until she tasted it all up.
text.T1: Iye anatenga SIPUNI YAYIKULU ija ndikulawa phala lomwe linali M’MBALE YAIKULU, koma linali lotentha kwambiri. Pambuyo pake, anatenga sipuni yapakati ndi pakati ndi kulawa phala lomwe linali m’mbale yapakati ndi pakati, ndipo linali lozizira kwambiri. Motero iye anatenga sipuni yaing’ono ya siliva ndi kulawa phala m’mbale ya wokondedwa wacicepere, ndipo linamveka bwino. Linamveka bwino mwakutianalawa ndi kulawa,ndi kulawa ndi kulawa mpaka kulawiratu phala lonse.
text.T2: Iye anatenga SIPUNI YAYIKULU kwambiri ndikulawa phala lomwe linali M’MBALE YAIKULU kwambiri, koma linali lotentha kwambiri. Pambuyo pake, anatenga sipuni yapakati ndi pakati ndi kulawa phala lomwe linali m’mbale yapakati ndi pakati, ndipo linali lozizira. Motero iye anatenga sipuni yaying’ono ya siliva ndi kulawa phala m’mbale yaing’ono yokondedwa, ndipo linamveka bwino. Linamveka bwino mwakuti analawa ndi kulawa,ndi kulawa ndi kulawa mpaka kulawiratu phala lonse.

text.S1: And after that she felt very sleepy, so she went upstairs and looked about her, and there were three beds all in a row. The first bed was the GREAT BIG BED that belonged to the father lion. The second bed was a middling-sized bed that belonged to the mother lion, and the third bed was a dear little bed that belonged to the dear little baby lion.
text.S2: And after that she felt very sleepy, so she went upstairs and looked about her, and there were three beds all in a row. The first bed was the GREAT BIG BED that belonged to the father lion. The second bed was a middle-sized bed that belonged to the mother lion, and the third bed was a dear little bed that belonged to the dear little baby lion.
text.T1: Ndipo pocita izi anamva tulo, conco anapitapamwamba pasanjika ndi kupenya mozungulira, ndipo panali mabedi atatu mumndandanda. Bedi loyamba linali BEDI LALIKULU KWAMBIRI limene linali la tate mkango. Bedi laciwiri linali linali lapakati ndi pakati limene linali la mayi mkango, ndipo kabedi kacitatu kanali kabedi kakang’ono kabwino komwe kanali ka mwana wochepa wa mkango.
text.T2: Ndipo atacita izi anamva tulo, conco anapita pamwamba pasanjika ndi kupenya mozungulira, ndipo panali mabedi atatu mum’ndandanda. Bedi loyamba linali BEDI LALIKULU KWAMBIRI limene linali la tate mkango. Bedi laciwiri linali lapakati ndi pakati limene linali la mayi mkango, ndipo kabedi kacitatu kanali kabedi kakang’ono kabwino komwe kanali ka mwana wocepa wa mkango.

text.S1: Goldi-Locs lay down on the GREAT BIG BED to try it, but the pillow was too firm and she wasn’t comfortable at all.
text.S2: Goldi-Locs lay down on the GREAT BIG BED to try it, but the pillow was too firm and she wasn’t comfortable at all.
text.T1: Goldi-Locs anali atagona pa BEDI LALIKULU KWAMBIRI kuti ayese, koma mtsamiro wake unali wolimba kwambiri ndipo sanakondwere ayi.
text.T2: Goldi-Locs anali atagona pa BEDI LALIKULU KWAMBIRI kuti ayese, koma mtsamiro wake unali wolimba kwambiri ndipo sanakondwere ayi.

text.S1: Then she lay down on the middle-sized bed, and the pillow was too soft, and that wasn’t comfortable either.
text.S2: Then, she lay down on the middle-sized bed, and the pillow was too soft, and that wasn’t comfortable either.
text.T1: Ndiye iye anagona pabedi yapakati ndi pakati, ndipo mtsamiro wake unali wofewa kwambiri,ndipo sanakondwere nawo ayi.
text.T2: Kenaka, iye anagona pabedi yapakati ndi pakati, ndipo mtsamiro wake unali wofewa kwambiri, ndipo sanakondwere nawo ayi.

text.S1: Then she lay down on the dear little bed and it was exactly right, and so very comfortable that she lay there and lay there until she went fast asleep.
text.S2: Then she lay down on the dear little bed and it was exactly right, and so very comfortable that she lay there and lay there until she went fast asleep.
text.T1: Ndipo iye anagona pa kabedi kakang’ono kabwino ndipo kanamuyenera, ndiponso kanamveka bwino mwakuti anagona mpaka anagona tulo.
text.T2: Kenaka iye anagona pa kabedi kakang’ono kabwino ndipo kanamuyenera, ndiponso kanamveka bwino mwakuti anagona mpaka anagona tulo.

text.S1: While Goldi-Locs was still asleep in the little bed, the three lions came home again, and as soon as they stepped inside the door and looked around, they knew that somebody had been there.
text.S2: While Goldi-Locs was still asleep in the little bed, the three lions came home again, and as soon as they stepped inside the door and looked around, they knew that somebody had been there.
text.T1: Pamene Goldi-Locs anali akadali gone pa kabedi kakang’ono, mikango itatu ija inabweranso kunyumba, ndipo itangothakufika pakhomo ndi kupenya mozungulira, inadziwa kuti winawake anali atabwera.
text.T2: Pamene Goldi-Locs anali akadali gone pa kabedi kakang’ono, mikango itatu ija inabweranso kunyumba, ndipo itangothakufika pakhomo ndi kupenya mozungulira, inadziwa kuti winawake anali atabwera.

text.S1: “SOMEBODY’S BEEN SITTING IN MY CHAIR,” growled the father lion in his great big voice, “AND LEFT THE CUSHION CROOKED.”
text.S2: “SOMEBODY’S BEEN SITTING IN MY CHAIR,” growled the father lion in his great big voice, “AND LEFT THE CUSHION CROOKED.”
text.T1: “WINA ANALI WAKHALA PAMPANDO WANGA,” unabangula tate mkango m’mawu ake, “NDIPO WASIYA WOFUWOFU MOSASAMALA.”
text.T2: “WINA ANALI WAKHALA PAMPANDO WANGA,” unabangula tate mkango m’mawu ake yakulu, “NDIPO WASIYA WOFUWOFU MOSASAMALA.”

text.S1: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” said the mother lion, “and left it standing crooked.”
text.S2: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” said the mother lion, “and left it standing crooked.”
text.T1: “Ndipo winawake anali wakhala pampando wanga,” unatero mayi mkango,”ndikuusiya mosasamala.”
text.T2: “Ndipo winawake anali wakhala pampando wanga,” unatero mayi mkango,”ndikuusiya mosasamala.”

text.S1: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” squeaked the baby lion, in his shrill little voice, “and they broke it”; and he felt very sad about it.
text.S2: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” squeaked the baby lion, in his shrill little voice, “and they broke it”; and he felt very sad about it.
text.T1: ”Ndipo wina anali atakhala pampando wanga,” analira mwana wa mkango, m’mawu ocepa mokweza, “ndipo wauphwanya;” ndipo anali wodandaula kwambiri.
text.T2: ”Ndipo wina anali atakhala pampando wanga,” analira mwana wa mkango, m’mawu ocepa mokweza, “ndipo wauphwanya;” ndipo anali wodandaula kwambiri.

text.S1: Then the three lions went over to the table to get their porridge.
text.S2: Then the three lions went over to the table to get their porridge.
text.T1: Ndipo mikango itatu ija inapita kutebulo kukatenga phala lawo.
text.T2: Kenaka mikango itatu ija inapita kutebulo kukatenga phala lawo.

text.S1: “WHAT’S THIS!” growled the father lion, in his great big voice, “SOMEBODY’S BEEN TASTING MY PORRIDGE, AND LEFT THE SPOON ON THE TABLE.”
text.S2: “WHAT’S THIS!” growled the father lion, in his great big voice, “SOMEBODY’S BEEN TASTING MY PORRIDGE, AND LEFT THE SPOON ON THE TABLE.”
text.T1: “Ici n’ciyani,” unabangula tate mkango, m’mawu ake aakulu, “ WINA WAKHALA ALI KULAWA PHALA LANGA, NDIPO WASIYA SIPUNI PATEBULO.”
text.T2: “Ici n’ciyani,” unabangula tate mkango, m’mawu ake aakulu, “ WINA WAKHALA ALI KULAWA PHALA LANGA, NDIPO WASIYA SIPUNI PATEBULO.”

text.S1: “And somebody’s been taking my porridge,” said the mother lion in her middle-sized voice, “and they’ve splashed it all over.”
text.S2: “And somebody’s been taking my porridge,” said the mother lion in her middle-sized voice, “and they’ve splashed it all over.”
text.T1: “Ndipo winawake wakhala akudya phala langa,” anatero mayi mkango m’mawu apakatikati, “ndipo wataya phala paliponse.”
text.T2: “Ndipo winawake wakhala akudya phala langa,” anatero mayi mkango m’mawu apakatikati, “ndipo wataya phala paliponse.”

text.S1: “And somebody’s been tasting my porridge,” squealed the baby lion, “and they finished it.” And the baby lion looked sad as if he were about to cry.
text.S2: “And somebody’s been tasting my porridge,” squealed the baby lion, “and they finished it.” And the baby lion looked sad as if he were about to cry.
text.T1: “Ndipo wina wakhala akulawa phala langa,” anakweza mawu mwana wa mkango, “ndipo watheratu kudya phala lonse.” Ndipo mwana wamkango anaoneka wokwiya ngati kuti angayambe kulira.
text.T2: “Ndipo wina wakhala akulawa phala langa,” anakweza mawu mwana wa mkango, “ndipo watheratu kudya phala lonse.” Ndipo mwana wamkango anaoneka wokwiya ngati kuti angayambe kulira.

text.S1: “If somebody’s been here they must be here still,” said the mother lion; so the three lions went upstairs to look.
text.S2: “If somebody’s been here they must be here still,” said the mother lion; so the three lions went upstairs to look.
text.T1: “Ngati munabwera wina wake ayenera kuti akadali mmene muno,” anatero mayi mkango; motero kuti mikango yonse itatu inapita pamwamba pansanjika kukafunafuna.
text.T2: “Ngati munabwera wina wake ayenera kuti akadali mmene muno,” anatero mayi mkango; motero kuti mikango yonse itatu inapita pamwamba pansanjika kukafunafuna.

text.S1: First the father lion looked at his bed. “SOMEBODY’S BEEN LYING ON MY BED AND PULLED THE COVERS DOWN,” he growled in his great big voice.
text.S2: First the father lion looked at his bed. “SOMEBODY’S BEEN LYING ON MY BED AND PULLED THE COVERS DOWN,” he growled in his great big voice.
text.T1: Poyamba bambo mkango unapenya pabedi pake. “WINA WAKHALA ATAGONA PA BEDI PANGA NDIPO WAGUZA ZOYALA PANSI,” unabangula m’mawu aakulu.
text.T2: Poyamba bambo mkango unapenya pabedi pake. “WINA WAKHALA ATAGONA PA BEDI PANGA NDIPO WAGUZA ZOFUNDA PANSI,” unabangula m’mawu aakulu.

text.S1: Then the mother lion looked at her bed. “Somebody’s been lying on my bed and pulled the pillow off,” said she in her middle-sized voice.
text.S2: Then the mother lion looked at her bed. “Somebody’s been lying on my bed and pulled the pillow off,” said she in her middle-sized voice.
text.T1: Tsopano mayi mkango unapenya pa bedi pake. “Wina wakhala atagona pabedi langa ndipo waguza mtsamiro,” anatero mayi mkango mu liwu lapakatikati.
text.T2: Tsopano mayi mkango unapenya pa bedi pake. “Wina wakhala atagona pabedi langa ndipo waguza mtsamiro,” anatero mayi mkango mu liwu lapakatikati.

text.S1: Then the baby lion looked at his bed, and there lay little Goldi-Locs with her cheeks as pink as roses, and her golden hair all spread over the pillow.
text.S2: Then the baby lion looked at his bed, and there lay little Goldi-Locs with her cheeks as pink as roses, and her golden hair all spread over the pillow.
text.T1: Mwana wamkangao anapenya pabedi pake, uyo anali atagona Goldi-Locs wocepa ndi matsaya amaonekedwe a ofiirira monga maluwa, ndipo tsitsi lake lagolide lili loyala pa mtsamiro.
text.T2: Mwana wamkangao anapenya pabedi pake, uyo anali atagona Goldi-Locs wocepa ndi matsaya amaonekedwe a ofiirira monga maluwa, ndipo tsitsi lake lagolide lili loyala pa mtsamiro.

text.S1: “Somebody’s been lying in my bed,” squeaked the baby lion joyfully, “and she is still here!”

text.T1: “Winawakewakhala akugona pabedi panga,” anakuwa mwana wamkango mokondwa.”ndipo akadalipo.”
text.T2: “Winawake wakhala akugona pabedi panga,” anakuwa mwana wamkango mokondwa.”ndipo akadalipo.”

text.S1: Now when Goldi-Locs heard the great big father lion’s voice she dreamed it was the thunder rolling through the heavens.
text.S2: Now when Goldi-Locs heard the great big father lion’s voice she dreamed it was the thunder rolling through the heavens.
text.T1: Tsopano pamene Goldi-Locs anamva mawu akubangula a bambo mkango analota kuti inali mphezi ikulira mu mlengalenga.
text.T2: Tsopano pamene Goldi-Locs anamva mawu akubangula a bambo mkango analota kuti cinali civomelezi cikulira mu mlengalenga.

text.S1: And when she heard the mother lion’s middle-sized voice she dreamed it was the wind blowing through the trees.
text.S2: And when she heard the mother lion’s middle-sized voice she dreamed it was the wind blowing through the trees.
text.T1: Ndipo anamvera mawu amayi mkango apakatikati analota kuti ndi mphepo ikuwomba kupyola mitengo.
text.T2: Ndipo anamvera mawu amayi mkango apakatikati analota kuti ndi mphepo ikuwomba kupyola mitengo.

text.S1: But when she heard the baby lion’s voice it was so shrill and sharp that it woke her right up. She sat up in bed and there were the three lions standing around and looking at her.
text.S2: But when she heard the baby lion’s voice it was so shrill and sharp that it woke her right up. She sat up in bed and there were the three lions standing around and looking at her.
text.T1: Koma atamva mawu amwana wa mkango amene anali wokweza komanso akuthwa, mawuwoi anamuutsa. Anakhala pabedi ndipo mikango itatu inali inaimirira mozungulira ndikum’penya iye.
text.T2: Koma atamva mawu amwana wa mkango amene anali wokweza komanso akuthwa, mawuwo anamuutsa. Anakhala pabedi ndipo mikango itatu inali inaimirira mozungulira ndikum’penya iye.

text.S1: “Oh, my goodness me!” cried Goldi-Locs. She tumbled out of bed and ran to the window. It was open, and out she jumped before the lions could stop her. Then home she ran as fast as she could, and she never went near the forest again. And the little baby lion cried and cried because he had wanted to play with her.

text.T1: “Aaa,cabwino ico cinthu kwa ine,” analira Goldi -Locs. Iye analumpha kucoka pabedi ndi kuthamangira kuzenera. Zenera limenelo linali lotsekuka, ndipo iye analumpha pamene mikango ija isanamuletse. Pambuyo pake anapita kunyumba kuthamanga mofulumira, ndipo sanadzerenso kufupi ndi nkhalango. Ndipo mwana wamkango analira ndi kulira cifukwa amafuna kusewera naye.
